name: Delta SkyMiles® Platinum American Express Card

tripDelay.notes: Maximum 2 claims per 12-month period. Delay must be 6+ hours or require overnight stay.

tripCancellation.notes: Maximum $20,000 per 12 months across all claims.

lostBaggage.notes: High-risk items (jewelry, electronics) capped at $1,000 per person. Coverage applies when full fare is charged to card.

baggageDelay.notes: Coverage after baggage is delayed 6+ hours. Maximum $500 total.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Not a primary benefit on Delta SkyMiles Platinum.

emergencyMedical.notes: Global Assist Hotline: 24/7 emergency assistance coordination including medical referrals, emergency evacuation coordination. Cardholder responsible for medical costs.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary coverage — file with personal auto insurance first. Must decline dealer's CDW/LDW.

purchaseProtection.notes: Covers eligible purchases for 90 days from date of purchase.

extendedWarranty.notes: Extends manufacturer's warranty by 1 year on warranties of 5 years or less.

rewards.diningRate: 3x miles at restaurants worldwide including takeout and delivery

pointValue.transferPartners: Delta SkyMiles — can transfer from Amex Membership Rewards at 1:1

annualCredits.name: Delta Stays Hotel Credit
annualCredits.notes: $200 annual credit on prepaid hotels booked through Delta Stays.

annualCredits.name: Companion Certificate
annualCredits.notes: Annual companion certificate valid for a domestic round-trip Main Cabin companion ticket (taxes and fees from $22+) upon card renewal. Companion must fly same itinerary as cardholder.

freeCheckedBags.notes: First checked bag free for cardholder and up to 8 companions on same reservation when flying Delta.

inflight.notes: 20% savings on eligible in-flight Delta purchases as a statement credit.

milesRedemptionDiscount.notes: TakeOff 15: 15% discount when redeeming SkyMiles for Delta flights.

eliteStatusBenefits.mqdsBonus: Spend $25,000 on card per calendar year to earn 10,000 Medallion Qualification Dollars (MQDs).
eliteStatusBenefits.notes: Spending milestone MQDs help qualify for Delta Medallion status. MQD thresholds: Silver=5K, Gold=10K, Platinum=15K, Diamond=28K.

loungeDayPasses.notes: No Delta Sky Club access — that's reserved for Reserve card.

travelPerks: First checked bag free (cardholder + up to 8 companions)
Zone 5 priority boarding on Delta flights
20% savings on in-flight Delta purchases (as statement credit)
15% off SkyMiles redemptions on Delta flights (TakeOff 15)
$100 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
Trip delay coverage after 6 hours ($500/trip, 2 claims/year)
Lost baggage coverage up to $3,000 carry-on / $2,000 checked
3x miles on Delta purchases, restaurants, and U.S. supermarkets
bestFor: Frequent Delta flyers who value the companion certificate and faster path to Medallion status
